goal: Verify the integrated production candidate across both banks, browser workflows, migrations, recovery and release gates.
acceptance_tests: Clean and upgrade migrations and real PostgreSQL concurrency/recovery checks pass.
Builds, scans, contract tests, browser tests and deterministic end-to-end tests pass at one candidate commit.
Authenticated staging canaries pass independently for Bankone, Banktwo, both together and one-bank outage.
Restore and forward-recovery exercises preserve immutable revisions and avoid duplicate publication.
All eight independent reports reference the exact candidate and actual measured evidence.
A reviewable release candidate and rollout/recovery procedure exist; production deployment remains separately authorized.
forbidden_scope: Changing the autonomy policy or weakening required checks
Publishing secrets or private source payloads
Editing paths outside the assigned scope
Changing the requested gpt-6.1-sol / medium / Fast execution profile or silently falling back to another model or tier

compatibility.api: Preserve existing consumers with additive versioned fields; run compatibility checks.
compatibility.events: Preserve event identity and make duplicate delivery idempotent.
compatibility.schema: Forward-only additive migrations with clean and upgrade verification; no destructive edits to historical migrations.
